method: read-only git/AST/source scans; no repo mutation

findings.title: Monolithic 1,740-line projection dispatcher silently ignores unknown events
findings.measured_evidence: projections.py total 1740 lines; apply_event spans 58-1726 (1669 lines); reset spans 1729-1740; 45 PROJECTION_TABLES; 92 literal elements in event_type equality comparisons plus 10 literal elements inside 3 in-tuple/set comparisons (2 overlap; 100 distinct handled event types by AST union) plus 3 startswith families; the function ends with no else/raise after the last elif (tail 1715-1726), so unknown event types exit silently; rebuild_projections (database.py:104-112) replays every event, and unhandled types are silently dropped from projected state.

findings.title: Oversized functions concentrate complexity in 24 functions over 80 lines
findings.measured_evidence: Measured top-20 by AST body lines: apply_event 1669; run_step 218; run_one_loop 208; shadow_run 199; _html 197; run_cycle 179; build_snapshot 134; build_candidate 122; select_connector 114; dispatch 114 (roles/dispatcher.py:155-268); _one_candidate 110; run_evaluation 102; reconcile 100; execute_effect 99; decide 94; register_release 93; dispatch 92 (roles/adapter.py:216-307); tick_scheduler 91; two tests at 90. Distribution: 18 functions 81-160 lines, 6 functions 161+.

findings.title: Broad Exception/BaseException handlers swallow failure detail across 30+ sites
findings.measured_evidence: 123 except handlers in src modules; 9 BaseException, 29 Exception, 0 bare except. BaseException sites: artifacts.py:93, database.py:36/47, live_ingestion.py:108, obsidian/snapshots.py:41, effects.py:261, supervisor/controls.py:219, supervisor/worker.py:62. Broad Exception sites include command_center.py:94, evolution/acceptance.py:57/71, roles/dispatcher.py:202/241, reporting/briefing.py:45/93, voice.py:119/127, evolution/restore.py:153, supervisor/console.py:65, supervisor/service.py:123/135, supervisor/run.py:65/153/180, connectors/activation.py:223/236/240/292.

findings.title: No typing, lint, coverage, mutation, or CI gate exists
findings.measured_evidence: pyproject.toml declares setuptools + pytest only; dev dependency is pytest>=9,<10; no [tool.mypy], [tool.ruff], [tool.coverage], or [tool.mutmut] sections; no CI workflow exists in the repository (no .github, zero workflow yaml). Measured typing: 1440/1701 functions with parameters fully annotated (84.7%), 401 functions with untyped parameters, 11 typed module variables. Mutation evidence in R1 used a custom mutant harness (docs/remaster/evidence/r1/mutant_results*) rather than a configured runner.

findings.title: Fixture providers and local sinks are the only voice/briefing delivery substrate
findings.measured_evidence: voice.py:40-45 FixtureSTT declares provider 'fixture-stt'; voice.py:48-51 FixtureTTS declares 'fixture-tts'; VoiceGateway:61-150 has no runtime caller. briefings.py:75-77 deliver_local records briefing.delivered with sink 'local-test-sink'. connectors/fakes.py FakeConnector:18-55 is never referenced by source or tests. Executive entry points have 311 word-boundary / 344 substring test-side references measured by the frozen script scripts/remaster/r2/measure_test_references.py (evidence: R2_TEST_REFERENCE_COUNTS.json) and no caller reachable from the installed watchdog path, so fixture-only behavior cannot be presented as live capability proof.

findings.title: Every non-watchdog executive path is implemented but never scheduled or invoked
findings.measured_evidence: Definitions exist for tick_scheduler/enable_scheduler, portfolio select_projects, run_one_loop, MissionLoop.run_step, pipeline run_mission/run_candidate, run_cycle, promote_release, shadow_run, run_evaluation, sync_vault, ingest_documents, detect_research_items, generate_briefing, VoiceGateway, CommandCenterServer, and EvolutionControl. Source-tree call-site scan finds no caller reachable from the installed watchdog path; the only references are tests (311 word-boundary / 344 substring test-side references measured by the frozen script scripts/remaster/r2/measure_test_references.py (evidence: R2_TEST_REFERENCE_COUNTS.json)), docstrings, and call sites inside other unreachable executive modules (supervisor/evolution_control.py:122/161, evolution/cycle.py:182/186/230, v3_loop.py:208/250), so none of the 17 executive entry points is reachable from the installed runtime. poll_monitor (discovery_monitors.py:37-80) is called only by the unreachable v3_loop.run_one_loop.

findings.title: Parallel mission, execution, capability, and promotion controllers write the same state
findings.measured_evidence: Mission state is transition-validated in domain.py:28-47, projected from mission.state_changed at projections.py:131-141, appended by MissionLoop._advance at mission/loop.py:160-193, and appended directly by v3_loop.py:310-321 and 365-369. Three execution authorities exist: MissionLoop.run_step (mission/loop.py:236-453), pipeline.run_mission (execution/pipeline.py:430-515), and v3_loop.run_one_loop (v3_loop.py:175-382); MissionLoop dispatches roles directly (mission/loop.py:286) without the ActionEnvelope/effect gate. Promotion is duplicated between evolution/registry.py:214-277 promote_candidate and evolution/promote.py:168-222 promote_release, both writing release.slot_changed/release.promoted. Capability authority is split across control/broker.py PolicyBroker, control/capability_broker.py, and capabilities/registry.py.

findings.title: Runtime home switch has no release/commit identity pin and trusts caller-supplied state labels
findings.measured_evidence: FoundryPaths.discover (paths.py:13-23) selects JARVIS_HOME, else HERMES_HOME/foundry, else LOCALAPPDATA/hermes/foundry with no baseline-commit identity stored or validated. Supervisor generates a self-assigned instance_id (supervisor/service.py:28-32). supervisor_state trust_state is written from event payload with default 'LAB' (projections.py:1721-1726), so any caller can label itself. config/foundry.yaml:14 declares LAB while PROJECT_STATE.md:94 declares TRUSTED_AUTONOMOUS; live truth at R0 was LAB (R0-F018). No code binds the loaded source tree hash to the ledger or supervisor_state.

findings.title: Live scheduled task imports mutable editable main source
findings.measured_evidence: The main .venv editable .pth contains exactly 'C:\Users\b\Documents\ChatGPT\Autonomous AI powered by Hoowen\JARVIS-Foundry\src', so the scheduled process imports the mutable main checkout. installer.py:73-74 schedules 'python -m jarvis_foundry.supervisor.run --home "<home>"' and installer.py:124 resolves python_exe from sys.executable; no immutable release pointer or hash-bound deployment exists. R0-F005 observed the live process started before commit 93a3ddc and loaded this editable source.

findings.title: Committed planning and status docs contradict live source truth
findings.measured_evidence: PROJECT_STATE.md:13-37 reports an active 12-hour duty window, PROJECT_STATE.md:94 reports trust_state TRUSTED_AUTONOMOUS, and PROJECT_STATE.md:135-150 reports operational gate and waiver completion; config/foundry.yaml:2 has foundry.enabled:false and :14 trust_state LAB. V7_S13_FINAL_GATE.md:4/93/115-147 declares 13/13 slices PASS, suite 985 EXIT=0, and perpetual operation, but the preserved verifier audited HEAD c589d3b (R0-F001) and the live ledger has zero scheduler/cycle/action/briefing rows (R0 claim register). V5_READ_FIRST.md:100-114 still describes external/financial reconciliation authority superseded by the Post-V7 directive.

findings.title: Ledger schema has no foreign keys, triggers, or event-header hash chain
findings.measured_evidence: events table (migrations.py:13-31) stores payload_hash (CHECK length 64) but no previous_hash/header chain; source-wide scan finds zero FOREIGN KEY, REFERENCES, or CREATE TRIGGER statements; migrations.py contains only PRIMARY KEY and CHECK constraints. Event.validate (events.py:73-82) checks only non-empty id/type with '.' and payload hash. database.py:86-115 inserts rows without chaining or deletion protection. PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON (database.py:23) cannot enforce constraints that do not exist.

findings.title: 41 created event types have no projection, so replay silently loses their state
findings.measured_evidence: The frozen canonical census (scripts/remaster/r2/measure_event_types.py, evidence R2_EVENT_TYPE_COUNTS.json) counts 112 distinct Event.create event_type literals (method-dependent: exhaustive static resolution yields more); projections.py handles 100 distinct exact types (AST: 92 literal elements in equality comparisons plus 10 literal elements inside 3 in-tuple/set comparisons, 2 overlap) plus 3 startswith families (consolidation., emergency_stop., supervisor.). 41 created types are unhandled, including scheduler.enabled/disabled/tick/item_fired/item_registered/item_deferred/item_missed/suspended, portfolio.* (7), capability.* (4), connector.* (3), brokerage.* (2), shadow.* (3), evaluation.* (2), gate.decision, owner.command_recorded, mission.outcome.recorded, action.decided, briefing.recorded, candidate_root.registered, correlation.* (3), effect.reconcile_not_tested, evolution.mode_changed, pipeline.verification.recorded. rebuild_projections (database.py:104-112) replays and apply_event falls through silently, making rebuild non-equivalent to incremental appends.

findings.title: Credential flow stops at identifiers and caller-supplied performer/worktree is not bound
findings.measured_evidence: resolve_provider_auth (control/capability_broker.py:281-324) derives an auth_id from provider+mission+run and issues a capability when a credentials system row declares READY; no code path retrieves or hands a credential VALUE to an adapter, and no READY credentials system exists. CommandCenterServer.configure_owner (command_center.py:548-553) keeps the owner secret in process memory and is never hosted. deliver_worker_context accepts a caller-supplied worker string (worker_context.py:78-118). MissionLoop commit_after_pass uses resource['resolved_root'] from an event-projected row (mission/loop.py:403-408) without cryptographically binding the performer or canonical target. roles/adapter.py:230-246 passes os.environ wholesale to subprocesses.

findings.title: Installed runtime path dead-ends at Supervisor heartbeat watchdog
findings.measured_evidence: Only console entry point is jarvis -> cli.main:main (pyproject.toml:23). cli/main.py:48-113 exposes init/status/doctor/stop/resume/events/install/uninstall/activate/deactivate only. The scheduled task runs python -m jarvis_foundry.supervisor.run (installer.py:73-74); Supervisor.start (service.py:34-65) initializes, reconciles, reaps workers, acquires lease, and appends supervisor.started; heartbeat (service.py:67-90) reaps, checks STOP, and appends supervisor.heartbeat; run.py:121-186 loops heartbeat only. No scheduler, portfolio, mission, effect, command-center, briefing, voice, knowledge, vault, research, or evolution call exists downstream of the entry points.

findings.title: Five defined source symbols have zero references anywhere
findings.measured_evidence: AST cross-reference scan over all src and tests: DispatchError (roles/dispatcher.py:40), FakeConnector (connectors/fakes.py:18), _last_file_hash (live_ingestion.py:58), _latest (integrated_rollback.py:42), and make_hermes_adapter (roles/adapter.py:356) each occur only at their definition site (src_refs_after_def=0, test_refs=0).

findings.title: Command Center converts database failures into empty arrays
findings.measured_evidence: _safe_table (command_center.py:91-97) catches Exception and returns [] for every table read, so missing/corrupt tables or locked DB render as empty state; build_snapshot (100-233) uses it for briefings, voice, candidates, and other tables (e.g., :153-154).

findings.title: Scheduler is disabled by default and its tick only emits events
findings.measured_evidence: scheduler.py:1-5 documents DISABLED by default (observe-only); enable_scheduler (117-123) requires controller and appends scheduler.enabled; tick_scheduler (156-246) raises when disabled, then appends scheduler.tick and item_fired/deferred/missed events with fired=[] and no dispatch callback or mission trigger. No source caller exists.

findings.title: Portfolio decision model is unreachable and its events are unprojected
findings.measured_evidence: portfolio.py defines register_project:98-129, score_projects:161-167, select_projects:170-199, pause/resume/reprioritize, record_unknown:248-258, record_conflict:261-271; select_projects has no runtime caller. All portfolio.* event types (project_registered, status_changed, reprioritized, decision, deferred, unknown, conflict) are in the 41 unhandled projection types.

findings.title: Evolution cycle records manufactured hashes and a fixed evidence path
findings.measured_evidence: cycle.py:135-136 builds the baseline with source_commit='a'*40 and artifact_hashes={'baseline.txt': 'a'*64}; cycle.py:206-209 records evidence_hash='c'*64 and evidence_refs=['var/evidence/v6-s11/cycle-verdict.txt'], a fixed path. These manufactured values make promotion/release proof untrustworthy.

findings.title: Voice and briefing delivery remain fixture/local-sink only
findings.measured_evidence: VoiceGateway:61-150 uses FixtureSTT/FixtureTTS only and has no runtime caller; briefing planner generate_briefing:62-75 has no runtime caller; the only delivery implementation writes briefing.delivered with sink 'local-test-sink' (briefings.py:75-77). No provider receipt, owner channel, or English/Albanian integrated path exists.

findings.title: Event validation is minimal and JSON schemas are not enforced at runtime
findings.measured_evidence: Event.create (events.py:44-71) always stamps schema_version=1 and validate (73-82) only requires non-empty id/type containing '.' plus payload hash. Seven schema files exist (schemas/*.json) but no source module references them or uses a schema validator; pyproject dependencies are empty.

findings.title: Retry/timeout/idempotency controls exist but are partial and never exercised on a live path
findings.measured_evidence: Positives: busy_timeout=10000 (database.py:24); heartbeat lock retry budget 15.5s (_heartbeat_with_lock_retry, run.py:92-113); execute_effect exactly-once semantics with crash reap/freeze and terminal-state refusal (effects.py:181-279); system_actions UNIQUE(system_id,target_ref,payload_hash) (migrations.py:552 and 572). Gaps: scheduler has no dispatch timeout/backpressure; CommandCenterServer has no request budget; no live path exercises any of these controls; no provider timeout or cost receipt exists.

findings.title: Migration history is additive-only with destructive table rebuilds and no downgrade unit
findings.measured_evidence: SCHEMA_VERSION=32 with MIGRATIONS dict 1..32; CHECK-constraint changes are applied by CREATE-copy-DROP-RENAME rebuilds (e.g., candidates v17 at migrations.py:498-520, system_actions v20 at 557-585); no downgrade migration or interrupted-migration unit exists. reconcile (reconcile.py:121-220) rebuilds projections plus runtime state; rebuild_projections (database.py:104-112) replays events and silently skips the 41 unhandled event types.

findings.title: Tests are tmp_path-heavy but touch environment, subprocesses, sleeps, and real Task Scheduler
findings.measured_evidence: 920 test functions across 88 files; 84 files use tmp_path; 28 sleep calls; 68 subprocess hits; 44 env accesses; 19 network-import hits; 7 files use monkeypatch/capsys; 15 parametrize decorations; 0 fixed-port hits. conftest.py:5-9 inserts src into sys.path. test_installer.py creates/deletes real Windows scheduled tasks with staging names (4-43) and hard-kills spawned daemons (306-378); test_role_gateway_kill drives a staged gateway via HERMES_HOME (13-22); R1-F003/F004 documented host-suite failures from subprocess import identity and in-repo basetemp.

findings.title: Monitor polling consumes supplied items and never reads a real source
findings.measured_evidence: poll_monitor (discovery_monitors.py:37-80) requires caller-supplied poll_items and records them; v3_loop.py:250 calls it only inside the unreachable run_one_loop. Live enabled monitors were stale since 2026-08-13 at R0 (R0-F006).

findings.title: Knowledge ingestion, vault sync, and research detection are unreachable
findings.measured_evidence: ingest_documents (knowledge_ingestion.py:44-99), sync_vault (vault_indexer.py:51-110), and detect_research_items (research_queue.py:48-117) have no runtime callers; detect_research_items is only called from the unreachable v3_loop.run_one_loop (v3_loop.py:208). Live knowledge/vault data was stale at R0.

findings.title: Hermes adapter and worker spawner are not wired to runtime
findings.measured_evidence: HermesOneshotAdapter.dispatch (roles/adapter.py:216-307) exists and make_hermes_adapter (356-364) is dead (R2-F015); WorkerController.spawn (supervisor/worker.py:46-66) has no runtime caller. The isolated Hermes execution substrate is not part of the live path.

findings.title: Capability readiness is fragmented across three registries with inconsistent live labels
findings.measured_evidence: connectors/activation.py:180-196 records READY/NOT_READY/BLOCKED/NOT_TESTED activation rows; capabilities/registry.py:143-145 builds a reconciliation matrix; systems.py register_system (46-64) records probe_ref with the system. R0 observed the local filesystem connector labeled READY while its system projection said NOT_TESTED and no credential/capability delivery exists.

findings.title: Historical financial action families remain in source and planning
findings.measured_evidence: gates/owner_families.py:46 lists effectful classes including transfer and pay_invoice; config/foundry.yaml:34-38 still carries purchases/git readiness flags; V5_READ_FIRST.md:100-114 retains external/financial action language. The authenticated Post-V7 directive supersedes this and requires deterministic denial of money movement (R0-F014).

findings.title: Seven JSON contract schemas are unused by runtime code
findings.measured_evidence: Source-wide scan finds no import/read of any schemas/*.json file and no jsonschema usage; pyproject.toml declares no validation dependency. The contracts exist as documentation only and cannot gate event or action payloads.
